package.name: wojtek_structure_core
package.description:
ROS 2 driver for the Occipital Structure Core (STO2D-C) depth sensor, publishing colour and depth on RealSense-shaped topic names so consumers written against the D435 move over by changing a namespace.
The closed-source Structure SDK is NOT vendored and NOT a declared dependency: its path comes in through STRUCTURE_SDK_DIR, and without it the package still builds its SDK-free conversion layer and tests. Only the driver node is skipped.
